blocks.text: Shailendra Singh Khinchi, born in August 1975 in Educational Capital of M.P. i.e. Indore. He completed his graduation in B.Sc. in first division. He obtained his Post Graduation degree M.Sc. (Physics) with specialization in LASER Physics from the reputed Govt. Model Holkar Science College, Indore in 1998. He awarded Ph D degree by Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya, Indore in 2010 in Physics. Being the Merit Holder Student he is awarded National Scholarship by Govt. of India and NCC “B” certificate by 2 MP ARMD SQN, Indore. He also received Prizes in various competitions like essay, speech, cultural activities etc.

In August 1998 he served in I. K. Degree College, Indore as Asstt. Prof. in Physics Department. He joined Christian Eminent Academy of Professional Education & Research, Indore as Head, Department of Physics in August 1999. He established there Physics and Electronics Laboratories for B.Sc. and BCA students.

In June 2002, he joined Institute of Engineering & Technology (IET), a UTD of Devi Ahilya University, Indore as Lecturer (Applied Physics) in Applied Science Department. Based on his experience in Lab Development, he contributed significantly to establish Applied Physics Laboratory.

Having an experience of more than 28 years of teaching he is also working in a Research Group of Dr. Ajay Gupta Sir (Ex-Centre Director, UGC-DAE-CSR, Indore). He started his research work under the Supervision of Dr. S. N. Kane (Professor, School of Physics, DAVV, Indore) and Dr. Ajay Gupta (Ex-Centre Director, UGC-DAE-CSR, Indore). He has more than 25 research papers to his credit at National & International level. He is also a fello member of Indian Physics Association (IPA) and Indian Association of Physics Teachers (IAPT).

Currently He is serving as Professor – Applied Physics with various responsibilities like Chairman Board of studies – Applied Physics, Observer in different National and State level examinations with NTA, MP PSC etc., Master Trainer in different elections with local administration and Panel member of different selection committees.
